reason: Both are B2B packaging manufacturers with paper-based lines, so they share an industry. Greif's core is rigid industrial containers (steel, plastic and fibre drums, IBCs, closures) plus containerboard and reconditioning services. Ranpak's core is paper void-fill, cushioning and wrapping systems, with machines placed at customer sites and recurring paper consumables, aimed mainly at e-commerce and fulfillment shippers. The overlap is in the general packaging category and paper materials. The core products and the main buyers differ, so this is adjacent and not a direct competitor.
